now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
now.text: In episode 2, Butane burns down a building as part of an insurance scam. Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.

changes.evidence: In 'The Parker Luck' (episode 2) Spider-Man knocks Butane unconscious in a pet store and leaves him for the authorities; the MCU wiki gives Butane's status as In Custody (NYPD listed as his captors) and his gauntlets as In Custody, and his photo appears among caught criminals in 'Scorpion Rising'. Nothing shows him free afterwards, so 'At large' does not match where the show leaves him.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
now.text: After Otto's arrest, his technology goes to Oscorp, and a gas made from it gives Lonnie Lincoln rock-hard skin.

proposed.text: After Otto's arrest, Oscorp seizes his technology, and when the 110th hijacks the convoy, a vial of his Diox-3 gas gives Lonnie rock-hard skin.

changes.evidence: In 'Hero or Menace' (episode 9) Lonnie is exposed during the 110th's hijack of the Oscorp truck carrying Octavius's equipment: he knocks over a vial of Diox-3 (Octavius's own substance) already among the seized tech. The gas is not something made from the tech after it reaches Oscorp; Norman later says Oscorp recovered most of the equipment except a damaged Diox-3 vial.
